zh:
- Windows 列表和弹窗的鼠标滚轮滚动改为平滑过渡，减少滚轮跳动。
- Android 液态玻璃输入框会在键盘和焦点布局变化后重新采样背景，修复首帧放大或错位。
en:
- Windows lists and dialogs now use smooth mouse-wheel scrolling instead of abrupt jumps.
- Android liquid-glass inputs resample the background after keyboard and focus layout changes, fixing enlarged or misaligned first frames.
